title: A second home, and a full life outside class
lead: Supervised boarding on Yidi Road, and clubs, sport and practical skills for every student, day or boarding.

hostel.heading: The hostel
hostel.text: Boarding builds discipline and independence: students learn to wake early, attend prep, do lab work and follow daily routines. The hostel is homely, with good catering, healthcare and social provision, and 24-hour electricity through solar power.

facts.label: moved to Yidi Road, with almost 80 students
hostel staff for welfare, safety, discipline and guidance, including academic and moral support

hostel.weekend: Weekend routine: hostelites do aerobics on Saturday and Sunday, 6:30 to 7:30 a.m., with a trained fitness expert.

routine.heading: Daily routine
routine.text: Weekdays. Weekends add sport, laundry and supervised free time. [SAMPLE]

bring.heading: What to bring
bring.note: List [SAMPLE]. The full list is sent with the admission letter.

care.heading: Visiting and care
lines: Visiting day is the last Saturday of each month. [SAMPLE]
A sick bay on site, with parents contacted promptly if a child is unwell. [SAMPLE]

clubs.heading: Clubs and societies
clubs.text: Seven clubs, each with a teacher coordinator and student executives.

items.name: Health Science
items.purpose: Hygiene, disease prevention, interest in health careers

items.name: Press
items.purpose: Writing, basic journalism, reporting school events

items.name: Drama
items.purpose: Acting, confidence, public speaking, moral messages

sports.heading: Sports and fitness
sports.facilities: Every student takes part in at least one physical activity each week. A football pitch; volleyball, basketball and badminton courts; table tennis and fitness equipment.
activities: Football, the most popular sport: inter-class matches, friendlies and the annual inter-house
Indoor games: chess, scrabble, darts and table tennis
sports.competitions: Teams compete at zonal, local-government and state level, and have won medals in football, athletics and indoor games.
sports.schedule: Learners' sport is on Wednesdays, 2:00 to 4:00 p.m. Staff exercise on Wednesdays, 7:00 to 7:35 a.m.

character.heading: Character and leadership
character.text: The school teaches discipline, integrity and honesty, respect and tolerance, responsibility and hard work, through the code of conduct, assemblies, counselling, staff role-modelling and clubs.
points: Guidance and counselling: orientation for new students, academic and career counselling, personal and social support, exam preparation, moral re-orientation and work with parents
A student council: Head Boy and Head Girl, Sports Captain and Club Heads, with the science clubs
A two-week leadership training and certification at Sea School, Apapa, Lagos, an excursion for SS2 students

excursions.heading: Excursions
excursions.text: Educational trips each session. [SAMPLE: confirm the current programme with the school]
list: Old Oyo National Park: the first field trip, May 2007
Republic of Benin: first in August 2010, now for SS3 (Porto-Novo, Cotonou and Ouidah)
Kainji Lake National Park: yearly, for JSS3 and SS1
Esie museum, Arinta Falls, Ikogosi Warm Spring, Idanre Hill, the University of Ilorin and local industries

faq.q: Can a day student become a boarder?
faq.a: Yes, at the start of a term where space allows. Speak to the admissions office. [SAMPLE]
House staff keep a phone for calls home at set times; parents can call the house line. [SAMPLE]

faq.q: What happens if my child is unwell?
faq.a: They are seen in the sick bay, and parents are contacted. [SAMPLE]

cafeteria.heading: The school cafeteria
cafeteria.text: The cafeteria is open to students and staff. It serves healthy, affordable meals, with variety, snacks and drinks. It is clean and well managed, and table-manners messages are displayed.
